craft_notes: Sthāyin: sharing. Rows: offer, leave, give. Read aloud: portion.

lines: Then the sprinkled grain brought, on hearth-vessel-jar-fires share by share offered,
one share left over, to the pupil a share give.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tataś caruṃ prokṣitam ānīya sthaṇḍilakalaśakumbhavahniṣu bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ nivedya ekabhāgam avaśeṣya śiṣyāya bhāgaṃ dadyāt
